strategy: Elf self-mill combo — Morcant's Eyes token detonation
identity: A BG Elf self-mill combo deck that spends five or six turns turning its library into a number and then cashes that number in once. Morcant's Eyes reads '{4}{G}{G}, Sacrifice this enchantment: Create X 2/2 black and green Elf creature tokens, where X is the number of Elf cards in your graveyard' — and 19 of the 40 cards in this list are Elf cards, including Morcant's Eyes itself, which is a Kindred Enchantment - Elf and whose sacrifice is part of the activation cost, so it is already in the graveyard and counting itself when the ability resolves. Ten enabler copies bin cards for free while developing the board, and Lys Alana Dignitary's '{T}: Add {G}{G}. Activate only if there is an Elf card in your graveyard' is switched on by the same mill. The finish is Mirrormind Crown: 'the first time you would create one or more tokens each turn, you may instead create that many tokens that are copies of equipped creature' — attached to Dawnhand Eulogist, the X tokens arrive as X Eulogists, each of which reads 'each opponent loses 2 life', so the detonation deals 2X on resolution rather than waiting a turn cycle for summoning-sick tokens to attack. Moon-Vigil Adherents is a second, slower win condition reading an overlapping graveyard without needing the Eyes at all.

strategy_es: combo de automill con Elfos — detonación de fichas con Morcant's Eyes
identity_es: Un combo de automill de Elfos BG que gasta cinco o seis turnos convirtiendo su biblioteca en un número y luego cobra ese número de una vez. Morcant's Eyes dice '{4}{G}{G}, Sacrifice this enchantment: Create X 2/2 black and green Elf creature tokens, where X is the number of Elf cards in your graveyard', y 19 de las 40 cartas de esta lista son cartas de Elfo, incluida la propia Morcant's Eyes, que es un Encantamiento de tipo - Elfo y cuyo sacrificio forma parte del coste de activación, así que ya está en el cementerio contándose a sí misma cuando la habilidad resuelve. Diez copias de habilitadores entierran cartas gratis mientras desarrollan el tablero, y el '{T}: Add {G}{G}. Activate only if there is an Elf card in your graveyard' de Lys Alana Dignitary lo activa esa misma molienda. El remate es Mirrormind Crown: 'the first time you would create one or more tokens each turn, you may instead create that many tokens that are copies of equipped creature'; anexada a Dawnhand Eulogist, las X fichas llegan como X Eulogist, cada uno de los cuales dice 'each opponent loses 2 life', así que la detonación hace 2X al resolver en lugar de esperar un ciclo de turno a que unas fichas con mareo de invocación ataquen. Moon-Vigil Adherents es una segunda condición de victoria, más lenta, que lee un cementerio solapado sin necesitar los Eyes en absoluto.
